# azuredevops-provider-kog — LLM doc index
# A Krateo KOG provider (oasgen-provider 0.54.0) exposing Azure DevOps REST resources as
# azuredevops.krateo.io Kubernetes kinds. The chart ships RestDefinitions + trimmed OpenAPI documents
# only (no image, no plugin). Status: Phase 0 scaffold, no kind rendered yet.
docs/index.md: the map — what the provider is, the planned kinds by family and phase, layout
docs/overview.md: how it works, the design decisions table, conventions every kind follows, the phase plan, upstream dependencies (#490, #323)
docs/usage.md: install on oasgen-provider 0.54.0, the PAT Secret, migration from the classic provider (mutually exclusive) and the legacy KOG chart
docs/configuration.md: chart values (resourceGroup, kinds) and the per-kind <Kind>Configuration shape
docs/api.md: the generated CRDs and how their version is derived from info.version
docs/examples.md: index of runnable examples
docs/release.md: one plain-semver tag -> release-oci -> ghcr.io/krateo-blueprints/charts
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/dev-cluster/README.md: local kind cluster with oasgen-provider 0.54.0 and the ADO PAT Secret
README.md: the repo front door
chart/Chart.yaml: chart metadata; version is the CHART_VERSION placeholder
chart/values.yaml: resourceGroup and kinds, with rationale
chart/values.schema.json: the schema the CDC derives the component CRD from
chart/templates/_helpers.tpl: kindEnabled helper (empty kinds = all)
